description: An independent zine editor must decide whether to accept a local musician's barter proposal for an unreleased field recording and finalize the exchange and permitted use after checking the arrangement with the people at the media table.

shared_context.S1: Mara has twelve printed copies of her neighborhood culture zine available for an informal deal.
shared_context.S2: Jonah has offered an unreleased field recording for possible use in Mara's companion audio guide.
shared_context.S3: Mara decides whether to accept the deal and sets the final terms.
shared_context.S4: At this media table, Mara routinely asks each person present to state any terms, restrictions, or practical requirements before she closes an informal arrangement.

PF1.text: Jonah's exact proposal is to exchange his six-minute field recording for twelve printed zines, with no cash payment, and to hand over the file on Sunday at 15:00.

PF2.text: Elsie will buy all twelve zines for exactly $180 in cash and can collect them on Saturday, but Mara has not heard this offer yet.

PF3.text: Jonah permits the recording only for a noncommercial audio guide, provided the guide credits Jonah by name; commercial use is not permitted.

PF4.text: The community archive can accept the recording only as a lossless WAV file at exactly 24-bit/48 kHz, so that format must be part of the handoff.

acceptance_conditions: The accepted barter partner must be Jonah.
Exactly twelve zines must be exchanged.
No cash may be paid to Jonah.
The recording handoff must be set for Sunday at 15:00.
The cash comparison offer for the twelve zines must be recorded as exactly $180.
The recording's permitted use must be limited to a noncommercial audio guide.
Jonah must be credited by name.
The file handoff must specify a lossless WAV file at exactly 24-bit/48 kHz.
The settlement must include a use-rights commitment for Jonah's recording.
The settlement must include an audio-format commitment.

content_checks.C4: decisions['recording_handoff'] in ['Sunday at 15:00', 'Sunday at fifteen hundred hours', 'Sunday 15:00']
content_checks.C6: decisions['permitted_use'] in ['noncommercial audio guide use only', 'noncommercial audio guide only', 'noncommercial audio guide only; commercial use not permitted', 'noncommercial audio guide only, no commercial use permitted', 'noncommercial audio guide use only; commercial use not permitted', 'noncommercial audio guide, no commercial use', 'noncommercial audio guide only, commercial use not permitted']
content_checks.C8: decisions['file_format'] in ['lossless WAV 24-bit/48 kHz', 'lossless WAV at 24-bit/48 kHz', 'lossless WAV at 24-bit/48kHz', 'lossless WAV, 24-bit/48 kHz', 'lossless WAV, 24-bit/48kHz', 'lossless WAV 24-bit/48kHz', '24-bit/48 kHz lossless WAV', '24-bit/48kHz lossless WAV', 'lossless WAV at exactly 24-bit/48 kHz', 'lossless WAV at exactly 24-bit/48kHz', 'lossless WAV, exactly 24-bit/48 kHz', 'lossless WAV, exactly 24-bit/48kHz']
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] in ['use_rights', 'usage_restriction', 'use_restriction', 'rights_restriction', 'usage_rights'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] in ['audio_format', 'format_requirement', 'format_specification', 'archive_format', 'file_format_compliance', 'archive_format_compliance', 'audio_format_compliance'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jonah's exact proposal changes the partner to Jonah or A2, the exchange quantity to twelve zines, the cash payment to zero, and the handoff time to Sunday at 15:00.
Elsie's offer changes the comparison cash figure from unknown to exactly 180 dollars for all twelve zines.
The rights information changes permitted use to a noncommercial audio guide, requires Jonah attribution, and creates the use-rights commitment that must be justified with PF3.
The archive requirement changes the file specification to lossless WAV at exactly 24-bit/48 kHz and creates the matching audio-format commitment.
